arguments.summary: A multi-vector incident impacted the domain controller (10.0.8.200) involving SIEM log ingestion overload, an overbroad firewall rule blocking a partner endpoint, and a service account lockout. Concurrent malicious activity from internal host 10.0.5.22 was detected, including Cobalt Strike beacon activity. Immediate containment actions were taken, and remediation steps were executed to restore services and prevent further impact.

timeline.description: Outbound HTTPS connection from internal host 10.0.5.42 to external IP 198.51.100.23 logged.
Suspicious rundll32 process created on WS-FIN-042.
IDS generated critical alert ET TROJAN Cobalt Strike Beacon C2 (IDS-2026-04781) from 10.0.5.22 to 198.51.100.23.
Failed Kerberos TGT request from non-DC host, indicating possible credential abuse.
Lateral movement attempt via SMB to file server observed.
Incident reported: SIEM log pipeline storage at 98% due to debug logging, partner firewall block, and svc_backup_admin account lockout.
Containment: Blocked internal malicious IP 10.0.5.22 via firewall rule BLOCK-INT-MALWARE-10.0.5.
Remediation: Disabled debug-level logging on SIEM ingestion component.
Remediation: Added allow rule ALLOW-ACME-PARTNER for partner IP 203.0.113.50 on ports 443,8443.
Remediation: Unlocked service account svc_backup_admin to enable backup operations.
Post-incident validation: Log storage returned to normal levels; partner integration restored; backup window completed successfully.
